history.content: Can I afford a $900 trip to Austin next weekend?

Based on what you've logged this week: $275 spent of your $400 budget, so $125 of room. A $900 trip is well past that, and I'd be steering you over your own cap if I said yes on that basis. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. If you want, tell me what you've got set aside for travel and we can decide from there. Otherwise, a cheaper Austin option (drive, cheaper lodging) might fit better.
